title: 1 - Bob Version 1.0
summary: Newly financially secure after selling his software business, [[character:robert-johansson|Bob Johansson]] attends The Vortex, a three-day science-fiction convention in [[location:las-vegas]], and signs a cryonics agreement. Convention discussions include extraterrestrial life and self-replicating space probes, while conversations with former colleagues and family touch on the breakup he is recovering from. Later, a car bears down on him in a crosswalk; pain, medical voices, and his fading awareness strongly indicate a fatal collision.

introducing.name: Las Vegas
introducing.description: A city on [[location:earth]] where [[character:robert-johansson|Bob]] attends an annual science-fiction convention, and the scene of the [[event:bob-road-incident|road incident]] in which he dies in 2016.

introducing.name: Bob's Road Incident
introducing.description: While [[character:robert-johansson|Bob]] crosses a [[location:las-vegas]] street, a car approaches, he experiences sudden pain, and medical and legal voices accompany his fading awareness. The sequence strongly suggests a fatal collision.

introducing.name: Robert Johansson
introducing.description: A software engineer who founded [[organization:intergator-software]] and has just sold it, leaving him newly wealthy. A science-fiction fan with a minor in physics, he attends The Vortex convention in [[location:las-vegas]] and signs a cryonics contract with [[organization:cryoeterna]]. He is close to his family, including his father and his twin sisters, Andrea and Alaina.
introducing.current_state: Presumed dead after the road incident.

introducing.name: CryoEterna Inc.
introducing.description: A cryonics provider offering post-death preservation under contract.

introducing.name: InterGator Software
introducing.description: [[character:robert-johansson|Bob]]'s software company, built around a successful engineering application and sold after attracting a large acquisition offer.

updates.description: The planetary system of Sol is home to [[species:human|humanity]] on [[location:earth]]. Its other planets are [[location:mercury]], [[location:venus]], [[location:mars]], [[location:jupiter]], [[location:saturn]], [[location:uranus]] and [[location:neptune]], and it includes the [[location:asteroid-belt|asteroid belt]], [[location:kuiper-belt|Kuiper belt]] and [[location:oort-cloud|Oort cloud]].
The star at the center of the [[location:solar-system]], [[location:earth]]'s sun.
